description_en: Retrieve sensitive data identification results from Data Security Guard
description_zh: 该接口用于获取数据保护伞的敏感数据识别结果
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public dsg-query-sens-result --tenant-id 10241024 --db-type ODPS.ODPS --project-name project --schema-name schema --table table --col col --node-name Personal_information --level 3 --sens-status 1 --sensitive-id 10241024 --sensitive-name name --order DESC --order-field gmt_create --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --start-date example-string --end-date example-string --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DsgQuerySensResult

parameters.help_en: To obtain the tenant ID, log on to the [DataWorks console](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console), go to the DataStudio page, click your username in the upper-right corner, and then choose Menu > User Info
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID。您可登录[DataWorks控制台](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入数据开发（DataStudio）页面，单击右上方当前登录用户名称，选择菜单 > 用户信息，获取租户ID
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

- **ODPS.ODPS**

- **HOLO.POSTGRES**

- **EMR**
parameters.name: db_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the DataWorks workspace. You can find this on the workspace configuration page in the [DataWorks console](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的名称。您可以登录[DataWorks控制台](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间名称
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the classification node
parameters.name: node_name

parameters.help_en: The sensitivity level of the column
parameters.name: level

parameters.help_en:
The sensitivity status of the column.

Valid values: `sensitive`, `noIdentify`, and `noResult`
parameters.help_zh:
字段敏感状态：

sensitive：敏感
noIdentify：未识别
noResult：无结果
parameters.name: sens_status

parameters.help_en: The ID of the sensitive column
parameters.name: sensitive_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the sensitive column
parameters.name: sensitive_name

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:

- `DESC`: descending order.

- `ASC`: ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式：
- DESC：降序。
- ASC：升序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en:
The column by which to sort the results. Valid values:

- `gmt_create`

- `gmt_modified`
parameters.help_zh:
用于排序的字段：
- gmt_create
- gmt_modified
parameters.name: order_field

parameters.help_en: The page size. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大为20条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-dd或者yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，格式为yyyy-MM-dd或者yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: end_date
